comment: TODO: populate with mission scenarios. Each entry needs: name, description, objective, budget_usd, mission_months, difficulty (cadet/engineer/expert), required_objectives, allowed_orbits, allowed_instruments, event_frequency_multiplier, sandbox_mode. Optional unsuitable_instruments maps instrument id -> reason (soft warning on the Review screen). The destination follows from the chosen orbit (sandbox: picked by the player).

scenarios.name: Earth Observation
scenarios.description: Image a target region every week for two years.
scenarios.objective: Acquire weekly images of a ground region for 24 months.

unsuitable_instruments.sample_return: there's nothing to collect from Earth orbit — it's 500 kg of dead weight
unsuitable_instruments.radar_sounder: it's built to probe ice and rock on airless worlds, not to image a ground region every week

scenarios.name: Mars Reconnaissance
scenarios.description: Study Martian surface composition and geology.
scenarios.objective: Map surface composition across 3 Martian regions.

unsuitable_instruments.sample_return: this is an orbital survey — there's no lander to collect the samples

scenarios.name: Deep Space Weather Monitor
scenarios.description: Watch solar activity from L1 for 5 years.
scenarios.objective: Provide continuous solar wind and flare monitoring.

unsuitable_instruments.sample_return: L1 is empty space — there's no surface to collect samples from
unsuitable_instruments.radar_sounder: there's no surface below L1 to sound

scenarios.name: Sandbox
scenarios.objective: Design any mission you can imagine.
